newsitem.title: FRANCE: RALLYING-MITSUBISHI HIRE AURIOL FOR SAN REMO RALLY.
newsitem.headline: RALLYING-MITSUBISHI HIRE AURIOL FOR SAN REMO RALLY.

text.p: Frenchman Didier Auriol, the 1994 rallying world champion, will drive a Mitsubishi in the San Remo Rally next month to boost the Japanese car maker's chances to win the constructors title, the team announced on Monday.
Auriol, 38, has been without a car since the International Automobile Federation (FIA) banned his Toyota team for breaking world championship rules last season.
The Frenchman drove for Subaru in the Swedish Rally in February but has not driven in a world championship race since then.
"It is a fantastic opportunity for me to return to the world championship in the best car and the best team right now," he said.
Mitsubishi have already won the drivers world title thanks to Finn Tommi Makinen. The San Remo Rally, which Auriol has won three times, starts on October 13.
